Recording.title: Recording
Recording.description: A cloud-synced pronunciation audio recording for an IELTS vocabulary word or phrase.

wordId.description: Deterministic slug identifier for the word.

word.description: The English word or phrase being pronounced.

banglaMeaning.description: Bangla meaning or translation of the word.

audioDataUrl.description: Base64 data URL of the recorded or uploaded pronunciation audio.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the audio recording.

fileName.description: Original file name of the uploaded recording.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who uploaded the recording.

status.description: Publication status of the recording for cross-browser and incognito availability.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the recording was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the recording was last updated.

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: A recorded IELTS spelling practice session for a signed-in user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

totalWords.description: Total number of words attempted in the session.

results.description: Detailed per-word answer breakdown for the exam or practice session.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was completed.

AudioContribution.title: AudioContribution
AudioContribution.description: A user-submitted pronunciation recording sent to the Admin Panel for review to become the general app audio.

wordId.description: Deterministic slug identifier for the word.

word.description: The English word or phrase being pronounced.

banglaMeaning.description: Bangla meaning or translation of the word.

audioDataUrl.description: Base64 data URL of the contributed pronunciation audio.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the audio recording.

fileName.description: Original file name of the uploaded recording.

contributorId.description: Identifier of the user who submitted the contribution.

status.description: Moderation status in the Admin Panel.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the contribution was submitted.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the contribution was last updated or reviewed.

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: A password-protected user or admin account record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the account was last updated.

PersonalWord.title: PersonalWord
PersonalWord.description: A user-private struggling spelling word added by a student for their own personal study and practice.

wordId.description: Deterministic slug identifier for the word.

word.description: The English word or phrase the user is struggling with.

bangla.description: Bangla meaning or translation of the word.

example.description: Optional example sentence or spelling memory note.

ownerId.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns this private struggling word.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the personal word was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the personal word was last updated.

Contest.title: Contest
Contest.description: A scheduled multi-user strict spelling contest where words are deterministically locked until the exact start time so even the setter cannot see them beforehand.

creatorName.description: Display name of the contest setter.

pageFilter.description: Page pool for the contest words.

categories.description: Selected category names or empty list for all categories.

wordCount.description: Number of words in the contest exam.

baseSeconds.description: Minimum writing seconds per word in strict exam mode.

showBangla.description: Whether Bangla meaning clue is displayed during the contest.

durationMinutes.description: Window duration in minutes during which the contest stays open after startTimeMs.

randomSeed.description: Random cryptographic seed used to deterministically generate the hidden word deck at start time.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the contest was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the contest was last updated.

ContestSubmission.title: ContestSubmission
ContestSubmission.description: A participant's registration and strict exam submission for a scheduled contest.

timeTakenMs.description: Total elapsed time in milliseconds to complete the strict contest.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the participant registered or started.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was updated or completed.

WordOverride.title: WordOverride
WordOverride.description: An admin-defined global spelling and Bangla translation override for a catalog word that applies to all users.

wordId.description: Deterministic slug identifier for the catalog word.

word.description: Updated official English spelling for all users.

bangla.description: Updated Bangla meaning for all users.

updatedBy.description: Admin identifier or display name who updated the spelling.

status.description: Publication status of the global word override.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the override was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the override was last updated.

/recordings/{recordingId}.description: Stores admin-approved general pronunciation audio recordings indexed by deterministic wordId for all users who have not set a personal override.

/audioContributions/{contributionId}.description: Stores user-submitted audio contributions awaiting admin approval in the Admin Panel.

/practiceSessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores user-specific IELTS spelling practice history.

/userAccounts/{accountId}.description: Stores password-protected user and admin accounts.

/personalWords/{personalWordId}.description: Stores user-private struggling spelling words scoped strictly by ownerId.

/contests/{contestId}.description: Stores scheduled multi-user strict spelling contests.

/contestSubmissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores participant registrations and strict exam results for contests.

/wordOverrides/{wordId}.description: Stores admin-defined global spelling overrides that apply to all users.
